He played [[college basketball]] for the [[UConn Huskies men's basketball|UConn Huskies]]. He was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2024 class. ==Early life and high school career== McNeeley grew up in [[Richardson, Texas]] and initially attended [[J. J. Pearce High School]].{{Cite web |last=Insight |first=Pro |date=November 30, 2020 |title=Liam McNeeley Q&A |url=https://www.prospectiveinsight.com/post/liam-mcneeley |access-date=January 17, 2025 |website=Pro Insight |language=en}} He transferred to [[John Paul II High School (Plano, Texas)|John Paul II High School]] in [[Plano, Texas]] after his freshman year.{{cite web|url=https://www.dallasnews.com/high-school-sports/basketball/2021/11/24/john-paul-iis-liam-mcneeley-shows-why-hes-a-five-star-recruit-at-dallas-mavericks-fall-classic/|title=John Paul II's Liam McNeeley shows why he's a five-star recruit at Dallas Mavericks Fall Classic|first=Shawn|last=McFarland|work=[[The Dallas Morning News]]|date=November 24, 2021|access-date=November 12, 2023}} McNeeley averaged 17 points, nine rebounds, five assists, two steals and two blocks per game as a sophomore.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/nba/oklahoma-city-thunder/article/five-star-liam-mcneeley-montverde-academy-florida-eagles-indiana-kansas-basketball-recruiting-217854454/|title=5-star forward Liam McNeeley will announce on Sunday|first=Jeff|last=Rabjohns|website=[[247Sports]]|date=October 10, 2023|access-date=November 13, 2023}} After the season, McNeeley transferred a second time to [[Montverde Academy]] in [[Montverde, Florida]].{{cite web|url=https://www.dallasnews.com/high-school-sports/basketball/2022/06/02/john-paul-ii-five-star-recruit-liam-mcneeley-transfers-to-montverde-academy-fla/|title=John Paul II five-star recruit Liam McNeeley transfers to Montverde Academy (Fla.)|work=[[The Dallas Morning News]]|date=June 2, 2022|access-date=November 12, 2023}} He averaged 13.7 points, 4.5 rebounds, and 1.2 steals in National Interscholastic Basketball Conference (NIBC) competition in his first season at Montverde.{{cite web|url=https://www.kansascity.com/sports/college/big-12/university-of-kansas/article278709894.html|title=KU basketball recruiting: Liam McNeeley will visit Jayhawks|work=[[The Kansas City Star]]|date=August 29, 2023|access-date=November 13, 2023}} McNeeley averaged 12.5 points, 3.8 rebounds, and 2.8 assists per game for his senior year. McNeeley was selected to play in the [[2024 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]] during his senior year.{{cite web|url=https://www.dallasnews.com/high-school-sports/basketball/2024/01/23/texas-signee-tre-johnson-liam-mcneeley-make-2024-mcdonalds-all-american-game-rosters/|title=Tre Johnson, Liam McNeeley make 2024 McDonald's All American game|work=[[The Dallas Morning News]]|date=January 23, 2024|access-date=January 26, 2024}} ===Recruiting=== McNeeley was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2024 class, according to major recruiting services.{{cite
